text:
Gita Rao: @here Hosted Lumen (hosted-lumen.v1) is GA as of today :sparkles: — new low-cost quality tier for short-context interactive workloads. Rolling out in us-east-1, eu-west-1, ap-south-1.

Gita Rao: Quick summary: new endpoint https://api.redwood.com/v1/hosted-lumen ; streaming supports tiled/chunked responses and tool-calling-v2 with inline schema validation. Default quant profiles favor fp16/8bit-mix for latency-sensitive apps.

Gita Rao: Deprecation note: hosted-lumen-beta will be turned down in 60 days. Please migrate keys/agents to the v1 path.

Gita Rao: Example migration (curl):
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/hosted-lumen/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"lumen-lite","input":"Extract action items","stream":true,"tools":[{"name":"kb_search","schema":{"query":"string"}}]}'
```

OpsBot: deploy-bot: hosted-lumen.v1 rollout complete (us-east-1: 120 nodes, eu-west-1: 80 nodes, ap-south-1: 40 nodes). No service interrupts reported. :white_check_mark:

Marco Diaz: Congrats team! For partners using the legacy generate endpoint, is there automatic redirect or do they need to change their integration?

Gita Rao: Marco Diaz: No redirects. We chose explicit migration to avoid silent behavior changes. We will include a one-click SDK migration helper and a compatibility flag for 30 days.

Priya Singh: Heads-up: tool-calling-v2 changes the way optional args are encoded (now top-level vs nested). Will the SDKs be updated?

Gita Rao: Priya Singh yes, SDKs (python/js/go) get patch releases in the next hour. Backwards compatibility shims included, but recommend updating to v0.11+ to use full schema validation in responses.

DocsBot: docs-bot: Lumen GA docs live at https://docs.redwood.com/hosted-lumen/v1 and new migration guide uploaded to Console > Quickstarts. PR: #4582.

Elliot Chen: Any quota changes for trial orgs? I need to update onboarding for trial customers.

Gita Rao: Elliot Chen trial orgs keep the same token quota, but we lowered default streaming concurrency to 1 for trials. Paid tiers see no change. If you need higher for demos, open a ticket to @eng-sre.

Marco Diaz: Can we get a small writeup for partners explaining cost/latency tradeoffs vs hosted-standard? I'll add to partner playbook.

Gita Rao: Will add a short one-pager to the pinned Console docs and email partner leads.

Priya Singh: Can we do a 20m runthrough tomorrow (09:00 PT) for support/solutions on the schema diffs?

Gita Rao: Scheduled 09:00 PT tomorrow. Invite going out now.

Elliot Chen: :thumbsup: thanks everyone — great work to infra and runtime teams.
